furfural production could be carried out using heterogeneous catalysis and simultaneous stripping with a non-diluting gas (nitrogen) and high xylose initial loadings.

The main takeaway from our work is that
furfural can be obtained from xylose in a one-pot process with simultaneous stripping using nitrogen under semibatch conditions.
it is possible to obtain high furfural concentrations in the condensates and to reduce the amount of water to be removed in the downstream purification step.
furfural production could be achieved using a cheap catalyst, and the furfural formed could be easily separated from water using nitrogen as the stripping gas.
